banner.title: Demo mode
banner.text: Your account and menu are saved only in this browser — nothing goes to a server.

account.title: Account
account.description: This demo's account, stored only in this browser.
account.dataDescription: What you entered when you created the account.
account.name: Name
account.notice: Editing these details, changing your password, and actually deleting the account only exist in the version with a database. Nothing here was sent to a server.
account.wipeDescription: Removes every account, restaurant, and menu stored in this browser, including menus you opened from a link.
account.wipeLinks: Links you've already shared keep working: they carry the menu inside the address itself.
account.confirmText: Accounts, restaurants, and menus in this browser are gone right away. This can't be undone.

pages.onboardingDescription: Three details and your menu gets its own address. You'll add your hours, delivery area, and dishes in the next step.
pages.qrTooBig: The menu got too big for a QR code, which holds about 2,900 characters at most. The link still works — to get a QR code back, shorten the menu or set up a database.
pages.menuSummary: {categories, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} · {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
pages.needCategoryText: Items are organized into categories, like “Burgers” or “Drinks.”
pages.subscriptionNotice: Subscriptions only exist in the version with a database. In this demo, the dashboard and publishing are unlocked.

store.notFoundDescription: There's no menu published at /r/{slug} in this browser, and this link didn't bring the menu with it. Without a database, the menu travels inside the address: ask whoever sent it to copy the link again from the dashboard — the full link is long and some apps cut off the end.

qr.caption: to print on tables and packaging

actions.passwordShort: Your password needs at least 8 characters.
actions.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists in this browser.
actions.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Log in again.
actions.slugShort: The address needs at least 3 characters.
actions.slugTaken: This address is already taken. Choose another one.
actions.whatsappInvalid: Enter a valid WhatsApp number, with the area code.
actions.whatsappWithDdd: Enter the WhatsApp number with the area code. E.g.: (11) 98765-4321
actions.orderModesRequired: Turn on delivery, pickup, or both — otherwise no one can order.
actions.itemImageInvalid: Use an emoji or the address (https://…) of a photo.
